Strategy: Refine ratio-gated worst fit with a roomy threshold: bins at least three times the item count as roomy, and among them the loosest wins, while tighter bins use Best Fit ordering but lose to a roomy bin, plus an exact-fit bonus. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever a roomy bin exists, since Best Fit would take the tightest bin instead. Preserving bins may help small items, but spilling into loose bins can leave half-filled bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if r >= 3 * item else -(r - item) - 1000) for r in bins]
```
